Subject: Pilot capacity check - dedicated GPU runway (QuantumForge)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. QuantumForge is preparing to kick off the closed beta for our inference optimization stack the week of 2027-06-14 and we need to confirm dedicated runway sizing and a provisional hold while procurement finalizes the contract. High level ask below:

- Start date: target 2027-06-14 (pilot: 6 weeks)
- Required steady state: roughly 12 x A100-80GB equivalent (with burst to 20 for peak tests)
- Expected sustained concurrency: 200 qps across 8 model endpoints
- Data residency: us-west region (no cross-region fallback)

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provision a dedicated pool that meets that runway and, if so, whether you can place a soft hold on that capacity pending contract signature? Procurement will also need a simple SOW/MA plan to attach to PO. I attached a short spec sheet.

Appreciate a quick check — timelines are tight.

Thanks,
Ellen
Head of ML Infrastructure | QuantumForge
Attachments: QuantumForge_ProdSpecs_v2.pdf (pdf, 420KB)

Can ops/plan confirm:
- Current spare capacity in us-west (A100-equivalent) for a 6-week window starting 2027-06-14

Priority: high — they flagged the start date to sync with their beta. Rishi/Logan, can you take the check and get back with a short signal (green/amber/red) and recommended hold size? Hannah, I may need you to prep a canary rollout suggestion if we greenlight.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / team — did a quick inventory sweep for us-west A100-equivalent pool. Snapshot attached. TL;DR:

- Current usable spare capacity (A100-eq): ~96 GPUs across dedicated/dynamic pools (pre-maintenance)
- Committed upcoming reservations (next 60d): ~48 GPUs (includes two enterprise rollouts that are soft-booked for mid-June)
- Maintenance window: minimal but we have a firmware update tentatively 2027-06-20 affecting 6 nodes in us-west-2 (can be avoided by routing)

Recommendation:
- Soft-hold: reserve 14 A100-eq (this covers 12 steady + 2 buffer for burst) for 2027-06-14 -> 2027-07-26 as a provisional hold (no billing until PO in).
- Escrow policy: mark as "soft-hold" in the Capacity Dashboard and flag to SRE for non-preemptible routing during the window.

Risks / notes:
- If Q3 enterprise commits convert earlier than expected we may need to shift QuantumForge to a compatible A40-quant variant (slightly lower throughput, cheaper). We'll surface tradeoffs.

I've attached fleet_snapshot_20270517.csv with node-level details. Priyom, if you can create the internal reservation ticket + cost delta estimate, we can present a one-pager to procurement.

Rishi

Quick ops note — concur with Rishi's inventory readout. A few operational points:

- Autoscale interplay: to honor 200 qps across 8 endpoints we'll need to lock worker pool size and disable aggressive preemption for that window. That is doable but reduces burst flexibility for other customers.
- SLA implications: a soft-hold is fine, but any hard reservation (billing/reserved nodes) requires a signed reserved capacity contract.
- Cost ballpark: 14 A100-eq reserved as soft-hold => estimated delta ~$62k/month list; final price will include commitment term and possible credits.

If Sales wants the soft-hold I recommend we:
1) Create internal reservation ticket (INF-4128) with node IDs
2) Produce a 1-page SOW + escalation path for firmware/maintenance overlap
3) Pre-authorize SRE to route around the 6-node firmware window on 2027-06-20
I'll sync with SRE if you give the sign.

— Logan
Infra Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
